principles.name: The card is the occasion
principles.principle: Invites composes each event as one full-bleed shareable object (one image, one set line of type, contextual details woven into the card) so the artifact itself is beautiful enough to BE the invitation.
principles.application: Compose the kept line as a single sendable object, not a stack of rows: date small in caps at top, the day's kept line set in JeniHeroSerif cocoa as the one headline, kept marks beneath at even rhythm, all on uninterrupted cream. QA it by screenshotting daily, since the full screen is THE screenshot she posts: no banner, badge, or button may appear that she would want to crop out.

principles.name: Chrome dissolves; content is the interface
principles.tradition: Apple Invites / Apple platform design language
principles.principle: Launch coverage noted Invites' glassy translucent cells and controls floating over big beautiful cards: navigation defers to content instead of framing it.
principles.application: Over plate photography and carousel pages, render page dots, edit affordances, and the tab bar as quiet glass (the native Liquid Glass TabView already shipped does this); never an opaque bar that interrupts the page, and let cream or her photo run underneath every control so screens read as pages, not panels.

principles.name: Lower the threshold, honor the record
principles.principle: Journal's stated first design goal is consistency: remove every barrier to beginning, then let the accumulating entries themselves, in one calm chronological ledger, be the app's beauty.
principles.application: The kept line arrives pre-composed each morning (date and plan already set, one tap to keep a line, zero typing), and past days render as identical cream cards in a bound ledger so her archive reads like a kept journal she wants to scroll; state the run quietly in cocoa small caps (day 12), never as a flame or a threat.

principles.name: Two sizes: enormous and whisper
principles.principle: Apple's marketing pages persuade with one short declarative headline at maximum scale, tiny caption text, and vast emptiness between; scale contrast, not decoration, carries the message.
principles.application: Each carousel page gets exactly two type voices: the insight number or sentence in JeniHeroSerif at the locked 52pt hero register (down 1.5 lb) and its provenance whisper in small DMSans cocoa (from 4 weigh-ins over 9 days). Delete every intermediate size so the eye lands once per page.

principles.name: The object is the message; handmade outranks polished
principles.principle: Hermès lets the crafted object carry the story and, in its 2026 site, chose hand-drawn imperfection and texture over algorithmic polish as the highest luxury signal, while its brand codes stay fixed as trends pass.
principles.application: Her real plate photos are JeniFit's crafted objects: run them full-bleed and un-beautified (no filters, no AI cleanup) as the carousel's only imagery, matted by cream margins like plates in a printed cookbook; the imperfect kitchen light IS the authenticity Hermès pays illustrators for, and the codes (8 locked tokens, cream ground, the serif) never vary issue to issue.

principles.name: Considered omission
principles.principle: COS reads as luxury through proportion, material, and construction rather than ornament: modern, functional, considered means every element present is one that was deliberately kept.
principles.application: Strip the checklist of UI furniture: no card shadows, progress rings, badges, or dividers beyond a single hairline cocoa rule; spend the saved attention on proportion, a fixed vertical rhythm between kept lines and a margin grid that holds on every screen, so cream, cocoa ink, and the serif are the entire bill of materials.

principles.name: Asymmetry makes emptiness active
principles.principle: Kinfolk rarely centers anything; photos and text blocks sit asymmetrically so white space becomes a dynamic compositional element instead of leftover padding, a book-design habit applied to magazine spreads.
principles.application: Art-direct becoming's pages like spreads, not slides: hang the insight line from a high left margin, let the plate photo sit low and bleed off the right edge, and leave the opposing quadrant genuinely empty. If every page centers its content the carousel reads as a template and the turning-printed-pages illusion dies.

principles.name: Ma: the interval is content
principles.principle: Ma treats the pause between elements as meaning-bearing in itself and kanso omits the non-essential, so rhythm and emptiness are what give weight to the things that remain.
principles.application: Design the between: a beat of plain cream inside the page-turn before the next insight settles (the JFPageTransition motion tokens exist for exactly this), generous fixed air around each kept line so it reads as a held breath, and a hard rule against filling any gap with tips, upsells, or a second message.

principles.name: Few assets, deep materials
principles.tradition: Aman journals / luxury hospitality print (Construct identity)
principles.principle: Aman's identity says a lot with just a few assets: light letterforms drawn from ancient mark-making, an earthy sand-soil-clay palette, and tactile uncoated papers with sparing foil, so richness arrives through material depth rather than visual density.
principles.application: Treat cream as uncoated paper stock and cocoa as ink, holding contrast just short of black; set large numbers in the serif's lighter weights; and spend foil exactly once a day, the existing LANDED silk sweep as the single specular moment, the way Aman blocks gold foil on one cover line only.

principles.name: One idea per room
principles.principle: Modern exhibition practice gives each zone exactly one story with a headline message impossible to miss, pacing object density to the time a visitor will actually spend in the room.
principles.application: Each carousel page is a room: one signal (sleep, window, sweetness), one headline, one visual, and nothing borrowed from the next page; an insight needing two ideas needs two pages, and page order should pace like galleries: open strong with weight, breathe with a photo-only plates page, close with the from-jeni letter.

principles.name: Wall-text discipline
principles.principle: Museum labels run a strict tiered hierarchy (introductory wall text, key messages, object captions) written so a visitor can leave after any tier with the story intact.
principles.application: Give every surface exactly three tiers and no more: the serif headline (tier 1), one DMSans sentence of meaning (tier 2), and a provenance caption naming the collected field, from 4 weigh-ins (tier 3, which also satisfies the data-provenance rule). Copy that fits no tier gets cut, and the kept-line screenshot must still work read at tier 1 alone.

principles.name: Half the wall stays empty
principles.principle: Professional museum displays leave roughly 40 to 60 percent of space empty because selective emphasis beats comprehensive density; the surrounding emptiness is what confers importance on the objects shown.
principles.application: Curate, don't grid: the day shows her best one to three plate photos large rather than every snap as thumbnails, and each becoming page and the kept-line screen should audit to about half bare cream; when a screen drops below that, remove an element rather than shrinking everything.
